title: A valid carrier against the wrong join
teaches: PACB target references are resolved against the ordered PACT join by identity, including names and arity. Two structurally valid, same-length joins can still be the wrong join: changing arity or swapping names is status 1, reason 9.
observe: alpha and bravo are both one-lane registry-0 targets.
Changing alpha to two lanes makes the join semantically wrong.
Swapping only the ordered names is equally wrong.
Both refusals leave the canonical carrier loadable at status 0.
